item.tib: mdo sde dam pa yid bzhin nor bu las cho ga zab mo 'dod dgu gter mdzod
item.coloph: ces pa'i mdo sde yid bzhin nor bu 'di nyid spu rgyal gnas chen nye bar byang gi g.yu mtsho phyug mo nas/ mkha' 'gro bde chen dbang mo'i (mos) zab gter rin po che spyan drangs te bka' rgya gdab cing bzhag phyis su 'gro don dus la babs tshe sngar snga) phyi thams cad grub brgya'i gtsug rgyan shar rdza rin po che bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ khro sprul g.yung drung mthong grol sogs dam pa mang po'i bka' gter dag snang snyan rgyud sogs snying thig bcu gsum phab dgos kyi nan bskul dang / nye bar khyung dkar grub dbang gong 'og gi brgyud 'dzin kun dga' tshul khrims sku mched dang / stag bla seng ge nyi ma ri khrod mtshams pa thams cad kyi sgrab gnas 'dir rten skal du pheb rog gis nan bskul ched du/ khyung dkar brag dmar ri 'dus mdun mthong grol ri khrod du shog ser la dag par phab pas zab gter rin po che nyi zla'i 'od zer bzhin khyab pa shog cig gu/ dge'o/ thog ma'i yig ris byed po ris bral rgyal bstan yongs kyi snying por 'chang ba mthong grol ri khrod mchog sprul kun dga' rin po che'i bgyis pas dge legs kyi phyogs dus gnas skabs kun du bkra shis bde legs chen por yongs su khyab par gyur cig/
